question: Should LINE's shipped `after_receive_record` receive ACK policy remain supported while this PR changes the default acknowledgement boundary?
rationale: The PR changes public plugin adapter metadata, and automation cannot safely decide whether removing a shipped ACK policy is acceptable API direction for LINE plugin consumers.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep `after_receive_record` in `supportedAckPolicies`, document/test the new default behavior, and merge only after real behavior proof is added.

options.title: Approve the removal
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the plugin contract break and require docs plus upgrade notes before merge.

options.title: Keep current main behavior
options.body: Close or rework this PR if the shipped ACK-immediately-after-validation contract should remain the LINE default.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep `after_receive_record` in `supportedAckPolicies`, document/test the new default behavior, and merge only after real behavior proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and refactor history make vincentkoc the strongest current owner signal for the LINE ACK metadata and webhook files.
